destination.title: Quantum corrections and accessible field-space boundaries
destination.question: Which classical trajectories and boundaries survive quantum corrections, and what corrected geometry or additional light states determines their continuation or obstruction?
destination.summary: Keeps infinite-distance obstruction, finite-distance continuation and the identity of the light sector as distinguishable questions.

systems: The supplied Type IIA, Type IIB, F-theory, heterotic and four-supercharge examples

conventions: Retain source-specific frames and restrictions on fixed volumes
includes: Instanton effects, coupling corrections and proposed threshold interpretations
excludes: A universal mechanism for resolving all singularities

evidence.text: When do multiple brane wrappings produce an infinite particle tower rather than repeated descriptions or finitely many relevant states?

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Why can a non-critical string become tensionless at finite distance while a transverse gauge coupling remains finite? The authors question whether its non-BPS particle excitations actually form an infinite massless tower.

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can the nearly tensionless BPS string satisfy a string version of weak gravity relative to charged black-string solutions? The paper identifies relevant tensor and Green–Schwarz charge structures but leaves their quantitative comparison open.

sources.title: A Spin‐2 Conjecture on the Swampland

evidence.text: The D3 example tests whether an explicit string realization of a massive spin-2 mode has the tower and coupling scale expected from the conjecture.

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: Can these towers satisfy weak-gravity bounds or count particle excitations of wrapped strings?

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture and Towers of Tensionless Branes

evidence.text: How does restoring the parent N=2 spectrum alter possible particle and string towers?

sources.title: A Note on String Excitations and the Higuchi Bound

evidence.text: Does the tower of increasingly high-spin perturbative string excitations conflict with the de Sitter Higuchi bound, and what additional string-scale constraint follows if flat-space Regge behavior is required to persist to a specified ultraviolet cutoff?

sources.title: Fermions and the Swampland

evidence.text: Do charged open-string scalar modes satisfy the coupling bound independently of their expectation values? Expected nonperturbative towers and geometric uplifts have not been converted into quantitative tests.

sources.title: Fermions and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does the sectoral bound extend to every bosonic tower? Decompactification could separate the graviphoton scale from parent-theory breaking, but independent radius variation has not been established in a complete string construction.

sources.title: Higher-order corrections to mass-charge relation of extremal black holes

evidence.text: Do heterotic-string higher-derivative couplings satisfy the mass-lowering condition when a Reissner-Nordström background is available? The example makes this background conditional on a heavy stabilized dilaton and on preservation of the imported couplings.

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture and Scalar Fields

evidence.text: Choose coordinates adapted to a linear scalar combination, eliminate transverse kinetic mixing, and integrate the resulting metric. Appendix A rederives a formula attributed to earlier work.

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Allocate excitation among factors in proportion to their positive indices, then control integer rounding. For Jacobi products this yields a candidate large-level charge, whose survival still requires a nonzero final coefficient.

sources.title: A Spin‐2 Conjecture on the Swampland

evidence.text: When m/Mw is large, the paper proposes using an electromagnetic-dual vector before applying the WGC. It supplies no dual action or explicit bound, so the prescription remains a qualitative extension.

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: Bound the norm of dK, apply Cauchy–Schwarz to the path velocity, and integrate its total variation. The operation avoids geodesic solutions and supplies a lower bound for paths within the controlled metric region.

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture and Towers of Tensionless Branes

evidence.text: Period vectors, nilpotent-orbit expansions and axionic monodromies generate charge orbits. The construction seeks nontrivial infinite orbits whose charges remain within the subset of basis walls becoming tensionless.

sources.title: A Note on String Excitations and the Higuchi Bound

evidence.text: Introduce a cutoff Λ* for Regge extrapolation or the applicability of the Higuchi analysis to oscillator states. Separately compare closed-string decay rates with H to determine whether the relevant excitations can be treated as sufficiently stable spin states.

sources.title: Gopakumar-Vafa invariants and the Emergent String Conjecture

evidence.text: Do gauge-coupling asymptotics and charged BPS indices distinguish decompactification from emergent-string limits in five-dimensional supergravity, and do Calabi-Yau data satisfy the resulting geometric predictions of the Emergent String Conjecture?

sources.title: Quantum corrections in 4d $N$ = 1 infinite distance limits and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Do quantum corrections preserve the emergent-string classification of infinite-distance limits in 4d N=1 F-theory, and how must gauge thresholds and string-excitation masses enter the WGC away from strict weak coupling?

sources.title: The asymptotic Weak Gravity Conjecture for open strings

evidence.text: Can excitations of asymptotically weakly coupled axionic/EFT strings furnish the tower WGC for four-dimensional open-string gauge sectors when no critical heterotic string emerges? Which scale hierarchies determine whether this is a controlled four-dimensional question?

sources.title: Emergent strings, duality and weak coupling limits for two-form fields

evidence.text: Does weak coupling of a two-form field with finite gravitational strength force an emergent fundamental string, and how does this differ from weak coupling of a one-form field?

sources.title: Asymptotic safety, string theory and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Can string theory generate an effective gravity–matter theory with a long intermediate asymptotically safe regime, and what necessary scale-matching and weak-gravity conditions would such a scenario satisfy?

sources.title: The D1 / D5 system and singular CFT

evidence.text: What happens to the D1/D5 boundary CFT when mutually BPS subsystems can separate at zero energy cost, and can long-string dynamics explain its continuum, singular behavior, and apparently missing chiral primaries?

sources.title: Large Field Distances from EFT strings

evidence.text: Can fundamental axionic strings characterize infinite-distance limits of four-dimensional quantum-gravity EFTs and connect the string Weak Gravity Conjecture to the Distance Conjecture using EFT data?

sources.title: Swampland Conjectures for Strings and Membranes

evidence.text: How can charge, tension and a Weak Gravity Conjecture be defined for four-dimensional strings and membranes when their backreaction prevents an asymptotically free-state description?

sources.title: Emergent strings in Type IIB Calabi-Yau compactifications

evidence.text: Do type II infinite-distance limits of Type IIB complex-structure moduli space realize a unique critical emergent string with an accompanying particle tower, despite lacking wrapped branes that directly produce the required BPS string?

sources.title: Analysis And Spectral Theory Of Neck-Stretching Problems: Analysis and Spectral Theory...: T. Langlais

evidence.text: How can elliptic inverses be controlled as a cylindrical neck stretches, especially when the model operator has real roots, and what determines the resulting low Laplacian spectrum and light Kaluza–Klein towers?

sources.title: Fundamental Physics, the Swampland of Effective Field Theory and Early Universe Cosmology

evidence.text: How do the additional string sectors change the response to shrinking a compact spatial radius?

sources.title: A twist at infinite distance in the CHL string

evidence.text: Which space-time BPS algebra emerges when the nine-dimensional CHL string approaches its infinite-distance decompactification limit, and how is its twisting realized in the large-radius and T-dual small-radius descriptions?

sources.title: On TCS G$_{2}$ manifolds and 4D emergent strings

evidence.text: How do G4 flux, string indices, candidate G2 enumerative quantities, and stability of light states interact in a TCS emergent-string limit?

sources.title: Instantons and infinite distances

evidence.text: Which stable strings and excitations remain light after quantum corrections, and can their effects explain the proposed endpoint or the divergent local kinetic scales?

sources.title: Tensionless string limits in 4d conformal manifolds

evidence.text: How are overall-free infinite-distance limits of large-N 4d SCFTs classified by higher-spin decay rates and densities of states, what tensionless strings might describe them, and what do their towers imply for AdS scale separation?

sources.title: Towards the non-perturbative completion of 4d 𝒩 = 1 effective theories of gravity

evidence.text: Does consistency of string-derived 4d N=1 gravity require additional light states of non-perturbative origin, beyond corrections to EFT couplings, and how do these states enlarge the perturbatively accessible moduli space?

sources.title: E$_{9}$ symmetry in the heterotic string on S$^{1}$ and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Which affine gauge algebras arise from asymptotically massless heterotic-string towers at the infinite-distance limits of circle moduli space, and how do their vector states realize the lattice weak gravity and repulsive force conditions?

sources.title: Moduli-dependent Calabi-Yau and SU(3)-structure metrics from Machine Learning

evidence.text: Can learned internal metrics enable normalized particle spectra, their moduli dependence, bundle connections, special-cycle calculations, and fibration diagnostics? These questions motivate potential applications to string phenomenology, the distance conjecture, and stabilization.

sources.title: String Gases and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a gas of strings stabilize compactification moduli while respecting the proposed constraints on scalar potentials and the relative strength of gauge and gravitational interactions?

sources.title: Laplacian spectrum on a nilmanifold, truncations and effective theories

evidence.text: How do base sizes, fiber size, and quantized twist control spectra on a curved compact space? Since f=Nr^3/(r^1r^2), varying the fiber radius at fixed topology also varies the curvature scale.
